title: What is known of Tiny Parham the man
summary: Allen recalls seeing Parham on organ in 1938; Punch does not know where he was from.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Uh, do you know anything about Tiny Parham? I never did get to talk to him. I saw him play once at the Savoy Ballroom in 1938. Yeah. He's a big, big, fat doll was playing the organ. That's right. And I went over there with Mead Lux Lewis, and I said, who's the organist? He said, oh, everybody knows him. If you know him, that's Tiny. Yeah, that's right. A big, big, big fella.
But I didn't get to talk to him that night. Uh, did he come from Chicago, do you think, or where was he from?
Well, when I first saw him, he was living in Chicago, but really, with his home, I don't know if he was born in Chicago or not.
You never did hear him talk about one of them? No, never did. Because he died before anybody ever got to talk to him and find out about his life, I think.
